tax.text: She supports making corporations and investment income contribute more rather than cutting programs for working families.
tax.quote: Maria supports closing those loopholes, cracking down on offshore tax shelters, and making sure corporations that profit from American workers and infrastructure actually pay their fair share.

wages.text: She supports raising the federal minimum wage and protecting overtime pay.
wages.quote: Maria also supports raising the federal minimum wage so that work pays — reducing the need for government assistance and putting more money into the hands of people who will spend it in their local communities.

debt.text: She favors deficit reduction through tax reform rather than cuts to Social Security or Medicare.
debt.quote: She believes the path to fiscal responsibility runs through a fairer tax code that generates adequate revenue, not through cutting Social Security, Medicare, or programs that working families depend on.

housing.text: She proposes expanding the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit and investing in new construction to lower housing costs.
housing.quote: Lower housing costs by expanding the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit and investing in new construction, because the only lasting fix for rent is more homes.

schools.text: She supports restoring the Department of Education and funding public early-childhood and student-support programs.
schools.quote: I would restore the Department of Education and its important programs; fund universal pre-school programs for 4-year olds; provide support resources and wraparound services; work with local communities; and encourage innovation.

immigration.text: She supports a pathway to citizenship and expanding legal visa options for essential workers.
immigration.quote: Maria supports a fair, structured pathway to citizenship for immigrants who live, work, and contribute to our communities — especially those who have been here for years and have American-born children.

health.text: She proposes lowering Medicare eligibility to 62 and supports working toward universal health coverage.
health.quote: Maria will work with colleagues on both sides of the aisle to lower the Medicare eligibility age from 65 to 62 — matching the earliest age a person can receive Social Security benefits.

energy.text: She supports rapid clean-energy expansion while also prioritizing affordability, workers, and grid reliability during the fossil-fuel transition.
energy.quote: She supports a responsible all-of-the-above energy strategy that aggressively expands clean energy while managing the transition away from fossil fuels in a way that protects workers, keeps energy affordable, and maintains grid reliability.

tax.text: Joyce opposed a spending bill he said would impose a large tax increase and backed tax cuts for working families.
tax.quote: I cannot support a bill that paves the way for nearly two trillion dollars in deficit spending on social programs and one of the largest tax increases in American history.

wages.text: Joyce criticized a federal minimum-wage increase, citing projected job losses, and voted against the bill containing it.
wages.quote: The legislation also includes a 107% hike to the minimum wage which, according to the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office, would destroy 1.4 million jobs

trade.text: He described tariffs as a tool for the president to use in pursuing the administration's agenda.
trade.quote: He’s using tariffs as more of a tool—some would say club—to get people in line.

debt.text: He says Social Security and Medicare should be protected while also supporting reforms to keep them solvent.
debt.quote: Since day one, I have been committed to preserving and protecting Social Security and Medicare, both for today’s seniors and future generations of beneficiaries. These programs provide an important safety net and represent a promise between workers and their government

schools.text: Joyce voted for the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, which established a federal tax credit for contributions to scholarship organizations serving K-12 students.
schools.quote: Vote Question: On Motion to Concur in the Senate Amendment One Big Beautiful Bill Act

immigration.text: He reintroduced legislation to establish joint border operations centers and said it would help secure borders and disrupt criminal networks.
immigration.quote: This bill is a step towards restoring the rule of law and securing our borders by establishing critical joint operations centers

guns.text: Joyce voted for the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act while describing himself as a defender of gun rights who opposes partisan gun-control bills.
guns.quote: This commonsense, public safety bill proves that we can stop murderers without infringing on the rights of law-abiding Americans.

abortion.text: Joyce called the Supreme Court’s Dobbs decision a victory for states’ power to regulate abortion and for the sanctity of life.
abortion.quote: Today’s Supreme Court decision is a long overdue victory for states’ rights and the sanctity of life.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Joyce voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which bases school sports eligibility on sex at birth.
gender.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay

cannabis.text: Joyce introduced legislation to remove state-compliant cannabis from the federal Controlled Substances Act and create a regulatory framework.
cannabis.quote: My legislation answers the American people’s call for change and addresses our States’ need for clarity by creating an effective federal regulatory framework for cannabis

health.text: Joyce said he favors a patient-centered system in which patients and doctors make care decisions without federal-government interference.
health.quote: I firmly believe the best way to achieve that is to provide Americans with a patient-centered healthcare system in which patients and doctors can make decisions without interference from the federal government.

energy.text: Joyce backed expanding domestic oil and gas production to provide affordable energy, while also saying emissions can be reduced without sacrificing jobs.
energy.quote: By unleashing our domestic oil and gas production we can weaken Putin’s position of power, provide Americans with affordable energy, and reduce global CO2 emissions.

voting.text: Joyce voted for legislation requiring photo ID for in-person federal voting and documentary proof of citizenship for federal voter registration.
voting.quote: Requiring voter ID in federal elections isn’t controversial; it’s common sense.
